exposure: thin placenta (>1 standard deviation below the mean)
thick placenta (>1 standard deviation above the mean)
average placenta (within 1 standard deviation above or below the mean)
outcome: previa persistence at time of delivery
cohort: 239 singleton gestations with previa diagnosed at 18-24 weeks
finding: At diagnosis of mid-trimester previa, thick placenta is associated with persistence at time of delivery and delivery by cesarean section.
mod_finding: Thick placenta at diagnosis of mid-trimester previa is associated with delivery by cesarean section.
